resources.string: Delay queued novel downloads to reduce source rate limiting
The first queued chapter starts immediately. Later chapters from the same plugin wait from the previous start.
This delay applies only to queued offline novel downloads. Reading, browsing, library updates, manga downloads, and unmetered sources are not delayed.
No installed metered novel plugins are available.
Local and other unmetered sources always bypass pacing, even if an old override remains stored for their source ID.
